g.text: Deny: refused without asking, and the races Deny can be in
(Deny > Always > Ask > default; C1, C3, C4, C9, C13; H-082, H-085, H-086, H-118, H-126)
A. Deny set ahead refuses in words, with no Wait
row: payment Idle · call [wallet_usable and payer == 'agent' and eff == 'deny'] → Refused.
Deny beats an open Always (banda-integration rules check).
B. "Never pay" on a card sets Deny and sweeps
fill commit: Deny(wallet, 0x77e0…) in the Recipients doc;
this payment Refused; every other open ask and queued payment
it covers refused in the same commit (C9)
C. Deny committed while a payment is queued (the race with the lane)
[the Deny commit lands first (commit order decides, C1)]
Deny commit: payment Queued · deny_committed [payer == 'agent'] → Refused
the bytes are dropped; no nonce burnt; nothing signed after the Deny counts (C4, H-118)
Past the burn point the payment finishes and is reported;
the Deny applies from the next payment (H-085).
D. A crash, then a Deny, then the tool's rerun (H-126)
Stored bytes exist for the key: the rerun reaches run, which only
rebroadcasts and reports the lane's outcome; never "did not run"
